method: Read-only comparison of source Chapter6 pp88–92 and frozen model/analyzer; no live effects inspected.
source_locators: p88 (PDF97), Section6.1.2 Eqs6.1–6.2: decomposition after covariate effects are partialled out
p89 (PDF98), Eq6.5: total phenotype variance adds beta-transpose (Sigma_w+Sigma_b) beta to ACE
p91 (PDF100), Section6.2: generating variances and total variance
p93 (PDF102), paragraph immediately before Section6.2.1: explicit h2=sigma_A_squared/sigma_P_squared and sigma_P_squared=A+C+E
source_limit: Page93 explicitly defines the residual ACE ratio. Its denominator excludes the covariate-predicted contribution added to total phenotype variance in Eq6.5; the ratio is not inferred merely from pp88–92.
implementation_locators: simulation/openmx_production.R lines30–31,44–45: delta-method SE of same ratio
contrast_convention: Mean fitted residual h2 minus generating residual h2=.5; positive means upward bias. Dividing A by1.64 instead defines a different total-phenotype fraction and must not be substituted.

visual_evidence.finding: The numerator is sigma_A squared and denominator sigma_P squared; the printed denominator definition is the sum of A,C,E variances.
